services.name: 11'0 RSP Paddleboard
services.desc: Corpus Christi and its neighboring Islands are surrounded by beautiful bodies of water, which host a number of great fisheries and attractions. Whether you are looking for a fishing kayak, recreational model, or paddle board; Wind and Wave has what you need to get out and enjoy the Coastal Bend. We stock a variety of single-seaters, double-seaters, pedal-driven systems, Minn Kota trolling motor kayaks, electric/pedal hybrids, tandem pedal-drives, and paddleboards. We offer daily/weekly rentals on paddling models, and can arrange demos free of charge. Let us help outfit you and your family for a safe, fun, and efficient paddling experience! 120 ePDL PRO, 120 PDL PRO, Sonata 106 MK, Malibu
